description:
Log time for yourself against a service (ids from list_time_tracker_projects). date is YYYY-MM-DD, hours is a decimal stored exactly (0.1 = 6 minutes, no rounding; between more than 0 and 24). Optional note and task (a task id of this organization). Same validations as the app: the service must be on an open budget you can log against. Only @seoalive.com accounts can use the time tracking tools. To log time for other people use bulk_create_time_entries (managers only).

Cost: 2 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// log 1.5 hours against a service.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","service":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001","date":"2026-11-12","hours":"1.5","note":"Keyword research"}
```
name: create_time_entry

render_with.description: Render tool that can display this payload.

title: Log time entry
